title: Struct layout calculator
subtitle: Add fields, switch representation, watch the padding
empty: No fields: a struct with no fields is a zero-sized type (size 0, align 1).
reprRust: Default: the compiler may reorder fields. Today rustc sorts them by decreasing alignment, which minimizes padding, but this order is not guaranteed and can change between compiler versions.
reprC: #[repr(C)]: fields stay in declaration order and each is aligned like C would do. Predictable, required for FFI, but often larger.
